'''Danar Len''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] who worked for [[Mandal Hypernautics Corporation|Mandal Hypernautics]] during the years following the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Len was the lead designer of Mandal Hypernautic's [[Crusader-class corvette|''Crusader''-class corvette]]. The company offered the [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], but the Imperials only purchased two of them and declined to order any more. Len was left distraught by the loss of the contract, so he mothballed the ''Crusader'' design and left Mandal Hypernautics, despite the encouragement given to him by his colleagues to persevere with the design.
